stale.title: Data may be stale
stale.message: The latest values are temporarily unavailable. Previously loaded data remains visible.

partial.title: Partial data
partial.message: Some sources did not respond. Available results remain visible and are not treated as complete.

unavailable.title: Service unavailable
unavailable.message: A required service is unavailable. This section will recover when the dependency returns.

unsupported.title: Feature not supported
unsupported.message: This feature is not enabled by the current deployment configuration.
